_README: Hand-made phase onsets for the 83 s clip. EVALUATION ONLY. Nothing under src/excavator_cycles/ may import or read this file. See eval/README.md.

video._filename_note: SAME FILENAME as the 29.6 s dev clip that eval/labels.json describes, but a DIFFERENT video. Tell them apart by sha256 or length, never by name.
video._frame_note: The container header claims 2602 frames at 29.989 fps; only 2496 decode.
video._fps_note: Not the header's 29.989. The decoder places every frame at exactly frame / 30 (checked frame by frame with cv2 CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC), so seconds = frame / 30.

provenance.source: hand-decided by Aanya from the video, pasted as a frame list on 2026-09-26
provenance.method: manual review; NOT model output and NOT produced by the pipeline
provenance.purpose: checking candidate cues and pipeline output only

onsets._units: Same convention as eval/labels.json: frame f means the instant immediately before frame f, so its time is the timestamp of frame f.
onsets._order: The cycle repeats digging -> hauling -> dumping -> swinging. The first digging onset opens the first cycle; the last closes the third.

known_caveats: The digging-onset convention (how many frames after first contact) was not recorded for these labels, unlike eval/labels.json's +9 frames. Compare conventions before reading a small digging error as a pipeline defect.
Three cycles from one video. Any cue tuned while looking at these labels will score better here than on a video it has not seen; check it on eval/labels.json (the dev clip) too.
